title: waise_consensus pipeline parameters
description: Consensus structural variant (SV) calling pipeline (Waise et al., 2025): runs Manta, LUMPY, SvABA, DELLY, and GRIDSS on matched tumor-normal BAMs, panel-of-normals filters each caller's tumor calls, and merges the survivors into a Jasmine consensus VCF.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

csv.description: Path to a comma-separated sample sheet with columns: id, tumor_bam, tumor_bai, normal_bam, normal_bai.

publishDir.description: Directory to publish pipeline outputs to.

genome_build.description: Reference genome build. Aliases (grch38/38, grch37/b37/hs37d5/37) are normalized automatically. Use 'other' to supply a custom reference via --reference_fasta.

reference_fasta.description: Reference FASTA (optionally .gz). Required when --genome_build other; otherwise defaults to a build-matched public reference.

reference_index.description: Pre-built .fai index for --reference_fasta. Ignored for compressed (.gz) FASTA inputs, which are always re-indexed after decompression.

gridss_options.title: GRIDSS options
gridss_options.description: Only used when --run_gridss is true (see 'SV caller selection' below).

gridss_blacklist.description: GRIDSS blacklist BED file. Build-matched defaults are available for hg38/hg19.

gridss_properties.description: GRIDSS properties file. Defaults to the upstream GRIDSS repository's reference properties.

gridss_sv_pon.description: Explicit GRIDSS structural-variant panel-of-normals directory/file. Must be supplied together with --gridss_sgl_pon.

gridss_sgl_pon.description: Explicit GRIDSS single-breakend panel-of-normals directory/file. Must be supplied together with --gridss_sv_pon.

gridss_resource_bundle.description: HMF pipeline resource bundle used to auto-derive a GRIDSS panel-of-normals for exact --genome_build hg38/hg19 when no explicit PoN is given.

default_gridss_properties.description: Fallback source for --gridss_properties when not otherwise supplied.

caller_selection_options.title: SV caller selection
caller_selection_options.description: Enable or disable individual SV callers. At least 2 callers must stay enabled for consensus calling to run.

run_manta.description: Run Manta and include it in the consensus.

run_lumpy.description: Run LUMPY (via smoove) and include it in the consensus.

run_svaba.description: Run SvABA and include it in the consensus.

run_delly.description: Run DELLY and include it in the consensus.

run_gridss.description: Run GRIDSS and include it in the consensus. Disabling this also skips all GRIDSS asset validation and preparation, so GRIDSS-specific inputs are not required.

consensus_min_support.description: Minimum number of enabled callers that must agree on an SV for it to survive consensus filtering. Defaults to requiring every enabled caller (n/n). Must be at least 2, and must not exceed the number of enabled callers.
